sop_modules.name: Door Frame Painting Setup
sop_modules.description: Floor protection and hardware masking for door frame painting. Protection level varies by application method.

tasks.name: Floor Protection Setup (Brush/Roll)
tasks.description: Set up drop cloth under door opening for brush/roll work. Localized protection for drips.
tasks.notes: Protection continuity from other specs is handled at project level by estimation engine.

tasks.name: Floor Protection Setup (Spray)
tasks.description: Set up rosin paper with 8-foot radius from door opening for spray overspray containment.

quality_notes.all: Full radial coverage, all seams taped

tasks.notes: Protection continuity from other specs is handled at project level by estimation engine.

tasks.name: Wall Adjacent Protection (Spray)
tasks.description: Mask wall surfaces adjacent to door frame opening for spray overspray. Only needed if walls are already finish-coated.
tasks.state_condition_note: Task inclusion based on adjacent wall state is now driven by state_declarations.adjacent_state_protection_rules for wall_field. Engine evaluates wall_field state (SS_PAINTED_*) to determine if wall masking is required.

quality_notes.all: Complete coverage of wall adjacent to frame

tasks.name: Mask Door Hardware (Hinges + Strike Plate)
tasks.description: Mask hinges and strike plate with tape if doors/hardware are installed before painting. Covers hinge leaves visible from frame side and strike plate on latch jamb.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Floor protection first, then wall protection (if spray), then hardware masking (if doors installed).

sop_modules.name: Door Frame Initial Preparation
sop_modules.description: Surface prep before first coat. Includes inspection, sanding, filling stop nail holes, and caulking frame-to-drywall gap.

tasks.name: Inspect Frame Surface
tasks.description: Visual inspection of each frame set (left jamb, right jamb, head jamb, stop). Assess factory primer condition, identify defects, check stop-to-jamb junction.

quality_notes.QT3: Note obvious defects — dents, holes, damaged primer
quality_notes.QT4: Systematic inspection, mark all visible defects at 3 feet
quality_notes.QT5: Critical inspection under raking light, mark all imperfections

tasks.name: Sand Frame Surface (Prep)
tasks.description: Scuff sand factory primer with 180-grit for adhesion. Include all jamb surfaces and stop surfaces.

quality_notes.QT3: Scuff sand for adhesion — uniform scratch pattern
quality_notes.QT4: Full sand 180-grit — all surfaces including stop
quality_notes.QT5: Thorough sand 150-180 grit — perfect uniform surface

tasks.name: Fill Stop Nail Holes
tasks.description: Fill nail holes in door stop with lightweight spackle. Stop is typically nailed to frame; nail holes need fill before paint.

quality_notes.QT5: Fill every hole, no matter how small

tasks.name: Sand Filled Areas
tasks.description: Sand filler smooth, feather edges to blend with surrounding surface.

tasks.name: Caulk Frame-to-Casing Gap
tasks.description: Apply paintable caulk to gap between frame and casing. Standard NC gap treatment.

tasks.name: Clean Sanding Dust
tasks.description: Remove all sanding dust from frame surfaces with tack cloth. Critical for adhesion and finish quality.

quality_notes.all: All dust removed — surface must be clean to touch

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Inspect → Sand → Fill Stop Holes → Sand Fill → Caulk Reveal → Clean Dust. All prep complete before primer or first finish coat.

sop_modules.name: Door Frame Primer Application
sop_modules.description: Apply primer coat to frame jambs and stop. Conditional on substrate_condition = bare_wood.

tasks.name: Spray Primer on Frame
tasks.description: Apply primer coat via airless sprayer (310-411 tip). Cover all jamb surfaces, head jamb, and stop in single pass.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks.

tasks.name: Brush Primer on Frame
tasks.description: Apply primer coat with brush. Work systematically: head jamb → left jamb → right jamb → stop. Load brush lightly for inside corners.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Prime after initial prep. Primer is conditional — skip if factory-primed and assessed acceptable.

sop_modules.name: Door Frame Interstage Process
sop_modules.description: Light maintenance cycle between coats. Runs AFTER each coat EXCEPT the final coat. Per Fine Finish Doctrine §5.3.
sop_modules.run_rule: Runs AFTER each coat EXCEPT the final coat

tasks.name: Inspect Coat
tasks.description: Visual inspection of applied coat. Look for dust nibs, missed areas, surface texture issues on jambs and stop.

quality_notes.QT4: Systematic scan at 3 feet — mark all visible defects
quality_notes.QT5: Lighted critical inspection at arm's length — zero tolerance

tasks.name: Light Sand Between Coats
tasks.description: Scuff sand frame surfaces between coats. Grit per quality tier: QT3=spot sand only, QT4=220 grit full, QT5=320 grit thorough.

quality_notes.QT3: Spot sand only — visible nibs, rough spots
quality_notes.QT4: Light full sand 220 grit — entire surface
quality_notes.QT5: Thorough full sand 320 grit — uniform scratch pattern

tasks.name: Patch/Repair Defects
tasks.description: Fill any defects found during inspection. Address issues from previous coat.

tasks.name: Clean Sanding Dust (Interstage)
tasks.description: Remove sanding dust with tack cloth before next coat.

quality_notes.all: Complete dust removal before next coat

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Inspect → Light Sand → Patch (if needed) → Clean. Runs after each coat except the final coat.

sop_modules.name: Door Frame Finish Coat Application
sop_modules.description: Apply finish coat to frame jambs and stop. 2 coats standard. Work systematically around opening.

tasks.name: Spray Finish Coat on Frame
tasks.description: Apply finish coat via airless sprayer (310-411 tip for fine atomization). Systematic pass: head → left jamb → right jamb → stop.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks.

tasks.name: Brush Finish Coat on Frame
tasks.description: Apply finish coat with angled sash brush. Work systematically: head jamb → left jamb → right jamb → stop. For modified urethane: apply, tip once, walk away — do not overwork.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks.

tasks.name: Roll and Tip Finish Coat on Frame
tasks.description: Apply finish using Roll and Tip methodology: 4" mini roller deposits coating on jamb flats, angled sash brush tips for smooth finish. Inside corners: load brush lightly, work out of corner.
tasks.notes: Optional alternative to brush-only. Per Fine Finish Doctrine § 15.6. Faster on larger jamb surfaces.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Standard: 2 finish coats with interstage between.

sop_modules.name: Mortise Touch-Up
sop_modules.description: Touch up hinge mortises and strike mortises after door installation. Conditional on doors being installed before painting complete.

tasks.name: Touch Up Mortise Areas
tasks.description: Touch up exposed wood at hinge mortises (typically 3 per door) and strike mortise (1 per door). Apply same finish product used on frame. Use small brush for precision.

quality_notes.all: Complete coverage of exposed wood. Color match to surrounding frame.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Runs after finish coats if doors were installed before painting. Per research finding RF-008.

sop_modules.name: Door Frame Painting Cleanup
sop_modules.description: Final inspection, protection removal, tool cleanup.

tasks.name: Final Frame Inspection
tasks.description: Final quality check of all painted frame surfaces (jambs, stop). Verify coverage, inside corners, stop junction quality.

quality_notes.QT3: Quick glance at 6 feet — no obvious defects
quality_notes.QT4: Systematic scan at 3 feet — no visible defects
quality_notes.QT5: Critical inspection at arm's length — zero tolerance

tasks.name: Remove Hardware Masking
tasks.description: Remove masking tape from hinges and strike plate.

tasks.name: Floor Protection Teardown
tasks.description: Remove floor protection materials (drop cloths or rosin paper).
tasks.notes: Protection continuity/teardown across specs handled at project level.

tasks.name: Wall Protection Teardown
tasks.description: Remove wall masking (spray method only, finished walls only).
tasks.state_condition_note: Task inclusion based on adjacent wall state is now driven by state_declarations.adjacent_state_protection_rules for wall_field.

tasks.name: Clean Tools
tasks.description: Clean brushes, spray equipment, rollers. Proper storage or disposal.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Final inspect → Hardware unmask → Protection teardown → Clean tools.

frame_type_variants.name: Pocket Door Frame
frame_type_variants.description: Pocket door frames have no door stop (door slides into wall). Reduced surface area, simplified tasks.
frame_type_variants.notes: Stop-related tasks excluded. Split jamb design may affect head jamb access.

frame_type_variants.name: Cased Opening (No Door)
frame_type_variants.description: Cased openings have frame jambs but no stop and no hardware. No mortise touch-up needed.

frame_type_variants.name: Bifold Door Frame
frame_type_variants.description: Bifold frames have jambs and head but use track hardware instead of hinges. Stop configuration differs from standard swing doors.

task_modifications.reason: No hinge mortises — bifold uses track hardware

frame_type_variants.notes: Track hardware instead of hinge mortises. Stop arrangement may vary.

round_configurations.name: Prime + 2 Finish Coats (Bare Wood)
round_configurations.description: Full system for bare wood frames: primer → interstage → finish coat 1 → interstage → finish coat 2
round_configurations.notes: Interstage after primer and after finish coat 1. Final inspection after finish coat 2.

round_configurations.name: 2 Finish Coats (Factory Primed)
round_configurations.description: Factory primed frames: prep → finish coat 1 → interstage → finish coat 2
round_configurations.notes: No primer coat — scuff sand factory primer in prep phase. Interstage after finish coat 1 only.

assumptions.note: Installation sequence drives mortise touch-up task inclusion. Not explicitly documented in doctrine.

assumptions.value: Wall protection only needed when walls are finish-coated, not when primed
assumptions.note: MIGRATED: Now handled by state_declarations.adjacent_state_protection_rules for wall_field. Engine evaluates wall_field state (SS_PAINTED_*) to determine if wall masking task is required.

assumptions.value: Floor protection presence from other specs is project-level determination
assumptions.note: Per Protection_Zones_Reference: 'Specs are authored as complete processes; optimization happens at project assembly.' Engine handles zone sharing across specs.
